title: Stop labeling ordinary medically dead characters permanently unrevivable
acceptance_criteria: Analyzer readings do not infer permanent unrevivability from Dead state, damage totals or disabled ordinary-healing revival; default Human and Mouse consumers cover the correction.
Medical state, typed treatment, ordinary-healing death retention and explicit revival rules remain unchanged; no defibrillator, permanent-marker component or new gameplay policy is introduced.
Focused analyzer JVM/native checks, UI readiness and packaged artifact pass; connected UI review and owner acceptance remain separate.
manual_steps: Scan a healthy, critical and dead Mouse; repeat with Human/Pig. A normally dead body must show Dead without the false Unrevivable warning.
Use bruise packs on a physically damaged corpse and scan again: damage decreases, but treatment alone must not automatically revive it.
